schools: Melrose Leadership Academy at Maxwell Park
enrichment.summary: Farallon Consulting, LLC will investigate gaps in site data, write a report on the findings, and update the Phase I Environmental Site Assessment (a review of past land use and possible contamination) for the Melrose Leadership Academy at Maxwell Park project. It also covers project management and communications. Work is scheduled from September 12, 2024 to December 31, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $28,935.80 for King Construction Inspection at the East Oakland Pride Elementary site project
enrichment.summary: King Construction Inspection, Inc. gets more pay for inspector of record services, which are required state inspections of construction work, on the East Oakland Pride Elementary School site improvements. The contract limit rises from $22,968 to $51,903.80. The term stays the same, May 23, 2024 through December 27, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
